_meta.weighting: POPULATION-WEIGHTED over the metro boundary: sum(pop*conc)/sum(pop) across every 30 arcsec GHS-POP cell inside the Overture-derived boundary, concentration read at the native 0.1 degree grid. Replaces the previous single centroid sample.
_meta.populationSource: GHS-POP R2023A, epoch 2025, 30 arcsec, Schiavina, Freire and MacManus, European Commission Joint Research Centre, doi:10.2905/2FF68A52-5B5B-4A22-8F40-C41DA8332CFE. CC BY 4.0.
_meta.fallbacks: areaMean = boundary exists but GHS-POP finds no population in it, so cells are averaged unweighted. centroid = no usable boundary, previous behaviour. Counts in methodCounts.
_meta.limitation: the concentration grid is 0.1 degree (~11 km), so weighting redistributes within that grid rather than resolving below it. PM2.5 is TOTAL mass and includes mineral dust, which penalises arid metros for geology; see GROUND-FLOOR-SPEC.md.
_meta.precisionNote: stored to 4 dp to preserve rank order, which 2 dp destroys by manufacturing ties. Round to 1 dp for display.
